## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior. For a false positive, provide the public domain and evidence of the affected legitimate function.

## Environment and reproduction

Include the profile or subscription, source commit or build timestamp, PowerShell/Pi-hole version if relevant, and the smallest steps that reproduce it.

## Validation and workaround

Explain how you isolated the affected subscription and any safe workaround tried.

## Privacy check

Remove tokens, client addresses, private domains and browsing history. Do not paste complete query logs. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.
